name: What does the process involve when adding a door to an existing basement wall?

mainEntity.name: What does the process involve when adding a door to an existing basement wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: When creating a brand-new doorway in a finished or unfinished basement partition, the surrounding drywall and wall framing must be cut and reinforced. Once the new king studs, jack studs, and header are secured, the pre-hung door is shimmed, leveled, and fastened. After installation, the adjacent drywall requires taping, mudding, and texture matching, followed by casing trim and interior paint. Using a full-service remodeling contractor ensures you do not need to hire separate drywallers and painters to complete the doorway.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves opening the wall, building rough framing, installing and leveling the door, repairing surrounding drywall, and applying trim and paint.
